name: Atlantis Senior Secured Mortgage Fund
desc: For investors who value stable income and protecting their capital. The fund lends against Australian residential and commercial property, secured by registered first mortgages.
points: Diversified portfolio of property backed loans
security: Registered first mortgages over Australian property
suits: Investors who want steady monthly income and value protecting their capital.
strategy: The fund invests in carefully selected Australian residential and commercial loans, spread across a diversified portfolio. Every loan is secured by a registered first mortgage, so the fund is first in line to be repaid if a property ever has to be sold. Each loan is supported by a professional valuation, a conservative lending policy and a clearly defined exit strategy, and the portfolio is kept below a 70% loan to value ratio. The priority is protecting your capital while paying consistent monthly income.
risks: A borrower may fall behind or be unable to repay
Property values can fall, reducing the value of the security
Recovering money through a property sale can take several months
Your money is committed for the full term

name: Atlantis Enhanced Yield Opportunity Mortgage Fund
desc: For sophisticated investors comfortable with a higher risk profile who are looking for higher income. The fund lends against Australian property, secured by second mortgages.
points: Disciplined credit assessment on every loan
suits: Sophisticated investors comfortable with more risk in return for higher income.
strategy: The fund focuses on carefully structured loans secured by registered second mortgages over Australian property, where another lender already holds the first mortgage. Because it is repaid after that first mortgage, it earns a higher return. Every loan goes through disciplined credit assessment and a professional valuation, has a clearly defined repayment plan, and the portfolio is kept below an 80% loan to value ratio.
risks: Second mortgages are repaid only after the first mortgage, so any shortfall falls here first
A fall in property values has a bigger effect on this fund
A borrower may fall behind or be unable to repay
Your money is committed for the full term
